title: Expand exact K/V gather spans into bounded mesh packets
hypothesis: A small ready-valid RTL packetizer can replace abstract span packetization while preserving all tensor and placement metadata across the 4,096-packet full-tile boundary.

direct_comparison.primary_question: Can every exact gather span be expanded into ordered 256-byte, eight-flit packet commands without losing canonical addresses or terminal markers under backpressure?
include: positive aligned spans from 256 bytes through 1 MiB
source, destination, canonical address, tensor-plane, and placement metadata
same-cycle descriptor replacement after the final accepted packet

remaining_abstractions: Packet commands still require concurrent endpoint dispatch and receive-before-transmit installation.
Shared-mesh payload movement and canonical K/V ingress ejection remain uncomposed.
The external HBM controller and PHY remain outside the RTL boundary.
